lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A non-uniform grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible across the mid-lateral flank, with higher spatial density observed in the dorsal-posterior quadrant and larger, more isolated centroids located anterior to the pectoral fin insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots to form a series of rectangular grid nodes, most discernible in the mid-flank region where caustic light interference is minimal.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a high-contrast transition from high-luminance highlights on the dorsal aspect to deep shadow on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of echeneids is visible along the ventral silhouette, particularly concentrated posterior to the pectoral fin axilla; the entire dorsal-anterior region is overlaid with a high-contrast caustic network caused by surface water refraction.
